description: Publish durable events (events.event-envelope@1) as a developer app (ADR-014). The app token (sub app:app_<ULID>, project_id prj_<ULID>, env) may publish only event types app.<project_key>.<name>[.<more>], where project_key is 'p' followed by the project's ULID in lowercase (prj_01JAB... -> p01jab...). source must be 'app-' followed by the app's ULID in lowercase; actor is the app (or the on_behalf_of user). Events stores the token's env with each event: sandbox events are never delivered to production subscriptions nor shown to production apps. Rate and retained bytes are limited per project and environment by OpenVibe.Events.
